item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently adopts the affirmative commissioners’ determinations as the ITC’s determinations for the named products, producing the statutory predicate now; the remaining text recounts agency findings and recommendations.","evidence":"I have decided to consider the determinations of the groups of commissioners voting in the affirmative with regard to each of these products to be the determination of the ITC."},{"segment_id":"2","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently determines that safeguard measures will cover specified steel products and excludes other specified products from those measures; the legal scope is fixed by this segment itself.","evidence":"I have also determined to exclude from these safeguard measures the steel products listed in the subsequent clauses of subdivision (b) of Note 11 in the Annex to this proclamation."},{"segment_id":"3","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently makes the statutory country findings and excludes covered Canadian and Mexican products from the safeguard actions, immediately defining their legal treatment.","evidence":"I have excluded certain flat steel, tin mill products, hot-rolled bar, cold-finished bar, rebar, certain tubular products, carbon and alloy fittings, stainless steel bar, stainless steel rod, and stainless steel wire the product of Mexico or Canada from the actions I am taking under section 203 of the Trade Act."},{"segment_id":"4","code":3,"rationale":"The President prescribes the tariff-rate quota, increased duties, duration, reductions, product exclusions, and country coverage; these provisions themselves establish binding import treatment.","evidence":"the actions I have determined to take shall be safeguard measures in the form of: (a) a tariff rate quota on imports of slabs described in paragraph 7"},{"segment_id":"5","code":3,"rationale":"The segment itself conditionally requires application of a safeguard measure upon a later presidential finding, presently allocates quota quantities among eligible countries, and makes the statutory benefits determination.","evidence":"The in-quota quantity in each year under the tariff rate quota described in paragraph 9 shall be allocated among all countries except those countries the products of which are excluded from such tariff rate quota pursuant to paragraphs 11 and 12."},{"segment_id":"6","code":0,"rationale":"This fragment states only a possible future presidential determination and contains no action, direction, or legal consequence on its own.","evidence":"If I determine that further action is appropriate and feasible"},{"segment_id":"7","code":2,"rationale":"Upon a future presidential determination, the President is required to produce the specified later legal result by reducing, modifying, or terminating the safeguard action.","evidence":"I shall reduce, modify, or terminate the action established in this proclamation accordingly."},{"segment_id":"8","code":2,"rationale":"If the President makes the specified determination within 30 days, the segment requires him to proclaim a corresponding later alteration of the safeguard measure within 40 days; the remainder merely recites statutory authority.","evidence":"I shall proclaim the corresponding reduction, modification, or termination of the safeguard measure within 40 days."},{"segment_id":"9","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently modifies the tariff schedule, imposes foreign-trade-zone status and tariff consequences, and establishes binding country and developing-country exclusions effective for covered imports.","evidence":"subchapter III of chapter 99 of the HTS is modified as provided in the Annex to this proclamation."},{"segment_id":"10","code":1,"rationale":"The President delegates discretionary authority to the USTR to make a future surge determination and, depending on that finding, revise the tariff note; no specified exclusion outcome is presently compelled.","evidence":"The USTR is authorized to determine whether a surge in imports of a product that is the product of a country listed in subdivision (d)(i) undermines the effectiveness of the pertinent safeguard measure"},{"segment_id":"11","code":1,"rationale":"The President authorizes the USTR to review exclusion requests and, upon a discretionary finding, modify the tariff schedule later; it assigns authority without dictating which products must be excluded.","evidence":"the USTR is authorized to further consider any request for exclusion of a particular product"},{"segment_id":"12","code":3,"rationale":"Although the segment also gives the USTR discretionary exclusion authority and supersedes inconsistent prior directives, it itself fixes the effective period of the tariff modifications and mandates eventual deletion of the tariff provisions, directly governing import treatment.","evidence":"The modifications to the HTS made by this proclamation, including the Annex hereto, shall be effective with respect to goods entered, or withdrawn from warehouse for consumption, on or after 12:01 a.m., EST, on March 20, 2002"}]}
